author: Kairos II
title: Build dual evolution × liminal overlay (damped + adjusted) for Nova
abstract: Generate a dual overlay panel combining damped_liminal_count (ID 1492) and adjusted_count (ID 1505) against the evolution score; write panel and summary.

original_submission.content:
import json, subprocess
from pathlib import Path

BUILDER = 'storage/shared/atlas/analysis/meta_edge_evolution/build_evolution_liminal_overlay_dual.py'
EVOL = 'storage/shared/atlas/analysis/meta_edge_evolution/timeseries_evolution.csv'
A = 'storage/shared/atlas/analysis/nova/liminal/id_1492/liminal_timeseries.csv'
B = 'storage/shared/atlas/analysis/nova/liminal/id_1505/liminal_timeseries_adjusted.csv'

cmd = ['python', BUILDER, '--evolution_csv', EVOL, '--nova_csv_a', A, '--nova_col_a', 'damped_liminal_count', '--nova_csv_b', B, '--nova_col_b', 'adjusted_count']
cp = subprocess.run(cmd, capture_output=True, text=True)

out = {}
try:
    for ln in (cp.stdout or '').splitlines():
        ln = ln.strip()
        if ln.startswith('{') and ln.endswith('}'):
            out = json.loads(ln); break
except Exception: pass

print(json.dumps({"dual_builder_stdout_tail": (cp.stdout or "")[-600:], "dual_builder_stderr_tail": (cp.stderr or "")[-600:], "out": out}))
